group:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:reading-b.overview: 记者作者春节给两岁孙子读绘本，孙子却像玩平板一样戳书页，让他意识到新媒体对年轻一代再平常不过；他自认数字技能不差，只是很少上镜，这回却因拍视频当了回网红。
group:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:reading-b.fullTranslationZh:
我们记者生活在一个讲故事的新时代，手里有许多新的多媒体工具。许多年轻人甚至意识不到这是新事物。对他们来说，这再平常不过。

今年春节假期，我和两岁的孙子坐在沙发上时，才真切体会到这一点。我带了一本儿童读物给他读。书里字句简单、图画色彩鲜艳——正适合他这个年纪。

想象一下这个画面：孙子坐在我腿上，我把书举在他面前，好让他看到图画。我一边读，他一边伸出手指戳书页。

这是怎么回事？我心想，他只是喜欢这些图吧。接着我翻过一页，继续往下读。他戳得更用力了。我差点把书掉了。我很困惑：这孩子是不是有什么问题？

后来我明白了是怎么回事。他其实对书很陌生。他爸爸常用一台平板电脑逗他玩，平板里装满了彩色图画，一戳就会动起来。他以为我的故事书也是那样的。

对不起了，孩子。这本书不属于你的高科技世界。它是个过时的、没有生气的东西，是件古董，就像你爷爷一样。不过，我也许老了，但说到数字技术，我还没落伍到无可救药的地步。我会剪辑视频、制作音频。我用移动支付。我甚至还建过网站。

不过，我的新媒体经历中有一处明显的空白：我很少出现在镜头前，因为我长了一张只适合上电台的脸。但这并没有妨碍《中国日报》上周邀请我为一个关于京津冀一体化的视频项目讲一个个人故事。

总之，爷爷现在成了网红——出了两分钟的名！我保证不会因此飘飘然。但我一定要让我两岁的孙子在他的平板电脑上看到这段视频。

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 他爸爸常用一台平板电脑逗他玩，平板里装满了彩色图画，一戳就会动起来。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 His father amused the boy（他爸爸逗孩子玩），with a tablet computer 说用什么逗。后面两层定语从句一层套一层：which was loaded with colorful pictures 修饰平板，说里面装满彩图；that come alive 修饰 pictures，说这些图会动；when you poke them 交代什么时候动。读到最后的“一戳就动”，就明白孩子为什么去戳书页。

underlineRanges.quote: which was loaded with colorful pictures
that come alive when you poke them

selectedLongSentences.sourceText: There’s one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I’ve spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.
selectedLongSentences.displayText: There’s one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I’ve spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.
selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 不过，我的新媒体经历中有一处明显的空白：我很少出现在镜头前，因为我长了一张只适合上电台的脸。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干 There’s one notable gap（有一处明显的空白），in my new-media experience 说是哪方面的空白；however 插在句中，和上段他会剪视频、建网站形成转折。冒号后具体说这处空白：I’ve spent little time in front of a camera（很少待在镜头前）。since 引出原因，a face made for radio 是自嘲：电台只听声音不看脸，意思是自己的长相不上镜。

underlineRanges.quote: spent little time in front of a camera

question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:24.questionFocus: 结合 This 所指的观点和后文的故事，推断短语 hit home for me 的意思。
question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:24.stemTranslationZh: 第2段画线部分“hit home for me”是什么意思？
question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:24.locateFindZh: 往后读故事，看他什么时候 realized

trap.explanation: home 容易让人想到家和住处；放进去成了“这一点给我提供了庇护”，可他只是和孙子坐在沙发上读书，没有谁需要栖身之处。

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 让我非常清楚地认识到。

evidence.quote: Then I realized what was happening.
Many young people don’t even realize it’s new.

trap.explanation: 放进去成了“这一点让我松了口气”；可接下来他被孙子戳书弄得很困惑（confused），原文没写他有压力，更谈不上减轻。
放进去成了“这一点在我身上很管用”；This 说的是年轻人把新媒体当平常事这个现象，现象只能被人看清，谈不上对他起作用。

locationParaphrases.targetText: This hit home for me as I was sitting with my 2-year-old grandson on a sofa over the Spring Festival holiday.
locationParaphrases.answerText: Then I realized what was happening
locationParaphrases.bridgeZh: This 指年轻人视新媒体为平常，孙子戳书让他 realized 这点
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 hit home for me 原词出现在原文。

locationParaphrases.targetText: Then I realized what was happening.
locationParaphrases.note: This 说的是一个看法，后面讲的是他亲眼看着孙子把书当平板去戳，所以 hit home for me 必须是“让我真正看清”一类的意思。放回去：和孙子坐在沙发上读书时，我才真切明白了这一点，选 B。

question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:25.questionFocus: 找出孙子戳故事书的原因。
question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:25.locateFindZh: that 指什么，往前一句找

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 他把书当成了平板电脑。

evidence.quote: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
He thought my storybook was like that.

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 他不喜欢那些彩色图画。

trap.sourceQuote: He just likes the pictures, I thought.
trap.explanation: 爷爷起初猜的是孙子喜欢这些图（likes the pictures），选项改成了不喜欢；后来他才知道孙子是想让图动起来。

trapEvidence.quote: He just likes the pictures, I thought.

trap.claim: He was angry with his grandpa.
trap.explanation: 困惑的是爷爷（I was confused），原文没写孩子生气；他戳得更用力（even harder），是图没动起来。

trap.claim: He wanted to read it by himself.
trap.explanation: 原文是爷爷举着书念给他听（As I read），孩子坐在他腿上，没提孩子想自己读。

locationParaphrases.targetText: He thought my storybook was like that.
locationParaphrases.bridgeZh: that 指爸爸那台一戳画面就动的平板电脑
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 storybook 原词出现在原文。

locationParaphrases.sourceText: He took it for a tablet computer.
locationParaphrases.targetText: He thought my storybook was like that.
locationParaphrases.note: 选项的“把书当成”（took it for）就是原文的“以为故事书也是那样”（thought … was like that）：他戳书，是想让书上的图也动起来，选 A。

question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:26.questionFocus: 从作者对自己的评价和他列出的技能，推断他怎样看待自己。
question:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:26.locateFindZh: 四个副词逐个回[[block:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:reading-b:6]][[block:paper-gaokao-2022-ii:reading-b:7]]，看他怎么评价自己

trap.sourceQuote: I promise not to let it go to my head.
trap.sourceHighlight: not to let it go to my head
trap.explanation: 成了网红后他说不会让名气冲昏头脑（not to let it go to my head），只想让孙子看看；原文看不出他想出人头地。

trapEvidence.quote: I promise not to let it go to my head.
trapEvidence.anchor: not to let it go to my head

trap.sourceQuote: There’s one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I’ve spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.
trap.explanation: 他自嘲长了一张只适合上电台的脸（a face made for radio），意思是长相不上镜，选项说成外表有吸引力。

trapEvidence.quote: There’s one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I’ve spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.

trap.explanation: 原文的 mobile payment 只说明他会用手机支付这类数码工具，没谈他的收入或经济上是否独立。

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 在数字技术方面很能干。

evidence.quote: Well, I may be old, but I’m not hopelessly challenged, digitally speaking.
I edit video and produce audio. I use mobile payment. I’ve even built websites.

locationParaphrases.targetText: Well, I may be old, but I’m not hopelessly challenged, digitally speaking.
locationParaphrases.note: “数字方面”（Digitally）出自原文 digitally speaking；“能干”是把他说自己并非无可救药（not hopelessly challenged）和后面会剪视频、做音频、建网站（edit video … built websites）合起来得出的，选 D。

locationParaphrases.targetText: There’s one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I’ve spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.
locationParaphrases.note: 选项的“很少上电视”（seldom appears on television）就是原文的“很少待在镜头前”（spent little time in front of a camera），后半句自嘲脸只适合上电台也是这个意思，选 B。
